plan.title: v0.66.0 `_ts-build` guard breaks `task deft:*` on deposits containing a stray `packages/` tree (#2126 regression for git-vendored-payload repos)

narratives.Description: The v0.66.0 `:engine:_ts-build` guard switched from dist-presence to source-presence, so git-vendored-payload repos with a stray `packages/` tree under `.deft/core` hit `pnpm run build` at a deposit root that has no `build` script. Global `deft` still works; only the Task wrapper breaks.
narratives.Overview:
> Consolidated issue superseding #2141. Root cause is fully traced; #2141 contains the investigation trail (including an initial misdiagnosis that blamed `deft update`, since retracted).

## Summary

On v0.66.0, the entire `task deft:*` surface (including `task check`) fails with `[ERR_PNPM_NO_SCRIPT] Missing script: build` on any consumer whose `.deft/core` contains a `packages/` source tree. The engine itself is fine — global `deft` works against the same project — so this is purely the `task` wrapper via the `#2126` `:engine:_ts-build` guard.

The published npm content package is **not** at fault (it ships 0 `packages/` files), and `deft update` is **not** at fault (a clean-room `deft update` deposits 0 `packages/` files). The regression is in the v0.66.0 `#2126` fix's guard heuristic, which fires on deposits that carry a stray `packages/`.

## Recommended fix (safe, auto-heals, no file deletion)

Harden the `_ts-build` guard to require the **buildability precondition**, not just source presence — build only if `packages/cli/package.json` exists AND the deposit root actually has a `build` script.

Complementary (secondary):
- `deft doctor` advisory that flags a consumer `.deft/core` containing `packages/`.

Refs #2126. Supersedes #2141.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Edit `tasks/engine.yml` `:engine:_ts-build` script guard to require root `build` script via node check before `pnpm run build`. 2. Extend `packages/cli/src/doctor.ts` to assert advisory when consumer `.deft/core/packages/` exists. 3. Add fixture test in `packages/cli/src/doctor.test.ts` and extend `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/taskfile_engine_dispatch.test.ts` to verify guard behavior.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive consumer on a git-vendored-payload repo, I want `task deft:*` to no-op the build step when my deposit has stray source but no root build script, so that I can run framework gates via global `deft` without `[ERR_PNPM_NO_SCRIPT] Missing script: build`.

items.title: `_ts-build` no-ops on stray packages/ deposit without root build script

narrative.Acceptance: Given a consumer deposit with `packages/cli/package.json` but no root `build` script, when `:engine:_ts-build` runs, then it no-ops and `task deft:check:consumer` passes using global `deft`.
Given a real framework source checkout with root `build` script and no prebuilt dist, when `:engine:_ts-build` runs, then `pnpm run build` executes successfully.

items.title: `deft doctor` flags stray packages/ in consumer deposit

narrative.Acceptance: Given a consumer `.deft/core` containing `packages/`, when `deft doctor` runs, then it emits an advisory flagging the stray source tree.

items.title: Regression test for stray packages deposit shape

narrative.Acceptance: Given the stray-`packages/`-without-root-build fixture, when the regression test runs, then it asserts no-op build behavior and passing consumer check path.

expected_outputs: Hardened _ts-build guard; doctor advisory for stray packages/; regression tests
